definitions.explanation: The three qualities an athlete or martial artist must develop together: {心|しん} (spirit, mental strength), {技|ぎ} (technique) and {体|たい} (physical strength). A set phrase from sumo and the martial arts, now used across sports.

examples.japanese: {心技体|しんぎたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
examples.english: To train mind, technique and body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心技体|しんぎたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そろって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: A yokozuna is expected to excel in mind, technique and body alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{心技体|しんぎたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The coach says that to win matches, you need not just practice but a balance of mind, technique and body.

notes:
USAGE:
The order is fixed: {心|しん} first. The phrase stresses that mental strength matters as much as skill and fitness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心技体|しんぎたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そろう: to have mind, technique and body all in top form
- {心技体|しんぎたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧: being at one's peak in all three
- {心技体|しんぎたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to build up mind, technique and body
